title: Submit patent disclosure form
description: Faculty-guided research groups must file the IP disclosure form before the filing window closes for this cycle.
submission: Upload signed PDF on the research portal, no physical copy needed.

title: Pay semester hostel dues
description: Second installment for hostel and mess fees. Late payment blocks mess card renewal.
submission: Pay online via the hostel portal or at the accounts desk, 10am–4pm.

title: Round 1 hackathon team registration
description: Teams of up to 4 must register before slots close. First-year students are eligible for the beginner track.
submission: Fill the Google Form with team name, members, and track preference.

title: DBT scholarship bank re-verification
description: Students whose last transfer failed must resubmit passbook proof or lose this term's disbursement.
submission: Upload a clear photo of your passbook's first page.

title: Elective preference form
description: Rank your top 3 electives. Unranked students are auto-assigned remaining slots.
submission: Rank choices on the academic portal, editable until deadline.

title: Annual fest volunteer sign-up
description: Volunteer slots for the cultural fest across hospitality, logistics, and stage management.
submission: Sign up via the linked form, choose one team.

title: Society elections — voting closes
description: Voting for the student council representative closes the same evening as the hostel fee deadline.
submission: Cast your vote via the linked Google Form, one submission per student.
